entries.source: Yuvalar doğrudan kullanılabilir. (=) çift bağ yuvasıdır. Aynı iki uç arasında ikinci kez çiz: 1/2 > 2/2. Mevcut bağı silme.

entries.source: Deneye tek bir temiz başlangıç darbesi verir. Yalnızca çıkış ucu vardır.
entries.text: Supplies a single clean initial pulse to the experiment. Has an output node only.

entries.source: Gelen darbeyi erken konumda orta şiddetli tek bir tepkiye çevirir.
entries.text: Converts the incoming pulse into an early, medium-intensity single response.

entries.source: Kendisine ulaşan tüm kolları toplar ve deneyin son izini ekranda gösterir.
entries.text: Collects all branches reaching it and displays the final trace of the experiment on screen.

entries.source: Gelen akışı iki ayrı kola ayırır. İki çıkış ucu da kullanılmalıdır.
entries.text: Splits the incoming flow into two separate branches. Both output nodes must be used.

entries.source: Gelen izi zaman ekseninde ileri taşır; tepe yüksekliğini korur.
entries.text: Moves the incoming trace forward along the time axis while preserving peak height.

entries.source: Gelen izin yüksekliğini azaltır; konumunu değiştirmez.
entries.text: Reduces the height of the incoming trace without changing its position.

entries.source: Erken zayıf bir kıpırtı ve geç konumda güçlü bir tepe üretir.
entries.text: Produces an early faint ripple and a strong peak at a late position.

entries.source: Ölçüm ekranının ortasında geniş ve dengeli bir kubbe izi bırakır.
entries.text: Leaves a wide, balanced dome trace in the middle of the measurement screen.

entries.source: Tek darbeden birbirine bakan iki ayrı küçük tepe üretir.
entries.text: Produces two separate small peaks facing each other from a single pulse.

entries.source: Dar ve yüksek bir iğne tepki üretir; sönümleyici ile dengelenebilir.
entries.text: Produces a narrow, high needle response; can be balanced with an attenuator.

entries.source: Rengin oranını korur; seyrelmiş karışımın yoğunluğunu yükseltir.
entries.text: Preserves the color ratio while raising the density of a diluted mixture.

entries.source: Gelen sıvıyı aynı renk ve yoğunlukla iki eşit yarım doza ayırır.
entries.text: Divides the incoming fluid into two equal half-doses with the same color and density.

entries.text: Combines fluids arriving from two branches into a single vessel according to their quantity and density.

entries.text: Collects all fluids reaching it and measures color, density, and quantity.

entries.source: Numune 12'nin erken tepkisini sağa kaydırarak hedef izle çakıştır.
entries.text: Shift Sample 12's early response to the right to align it with the target trace.

entries.source: Atım Kaynağı tek başına iz üretmez; önce Numune 12'yi beslemeli.
entries.text: The Pulse Source produces no trace on its own; it must feed Sample 12 first.

entries.source: Numune 12'nin doğal tepkisi hedef izden daha erken görünür; ölçerden önce bir Geciktirici gerekir.
entries.text: Sample 12's natural response appears earlier than the target trace; a Delay Unit is required before the meter.

entries.source: Aynı numuneden hem erken ham tepkiyi hem de gecikmiş ve sönümlenmiş ikinci tepkiyi tek ölçerde topla.
entries.text: Collect both the early raw response and the delayed, attenuated second response from the same sample in a single meter.

entries.source: Hedef izde iki ayrı tepe var; akış Dağıtıcı ile iki kola ayrılmalı ve iki kol da Kayıt Ölçer'e dönmeli.
entries.text: The target trace has two distinct peaks; the flow must split into two branches via a Splitter and both branches must return to the Recording Meter.

entries.source: Sağdaki tepe daha geç ve daha alçaktır. Kolların birinde hem Geciktirici hem Sönümleyici bulunmalıdır.
entries.text: The right peak is later and lower. One of the branches must contain both a Delay Unit and an Attenuator.

entries.source: Bu deneyde yalnızca bir numune kullanılır; Numune 34 hedef izle uyuşmaz.
entries.text: Only one sample is used in this experiment; Sample 34 does not match the target trace.

entries.source: İki farklı numuneyi ayrı kollarda işle: erken tepkiyi geciktir, geç baskın tepkiyi sönümle ve aynı ölçerde birleştir.
entries.text: Process two different samples on separate branches: delay the early response, attenuate the late dominant response, and combine them in the same meter.

entries.source: Dağıtıcıdan çıkan iki kol farklı numuneleri beslemelidir: biri Numune 12, diğeri Numune 34.
entries.text: The two branches leaving the Splitter must feed different samples: one Sample 12, the other Sample 34.

entries.source: Numune 12 geciktirildiğinde hedef izdeki orta tepeyi oluşturur.
entries.text: When Sample 12 is delayed, it forms the middle peak in the target trace.

entries.source: Numune 34'ün geç tepesi fazla yüksektir; ölçere girmeden önce Sönümleyici'den geçmelidir.
entries.text: Sample 34's late peak is too high; it must pass through an Attenuator before entering the meter.

entries.source: Merkez kubbe üreten numuneyi sönümleyerek hedef izdeki yumuşak eğriyi elde et.
entries.text: Attenuate the sample that produces a center dome to obtain the soft curve in the target trace.

entries.source: Hedef iz tek ve geniş bir merkez kubbedir; bunu Numune 08 üretir.
entries.text: The target trace is a single wide center dome; Sample 08 produces this.

entries.source: Kubbe konumu doğrudur; geciktirme gerekmez. Yalnızca Sönümleyici ile yüksekliği düşür.
entries.text: The dome position is already right; no delay is needed. Only lower its height with an Attenuator.

entries.source: İkiz tepki veren numuneyi geciktirerek iki tepeyi hedef konumuna taşı.
entries.text: Delay the twin-response sample to move both peaks to the target position.

entries.source: Dağıtıcı kullanmadan iki küçük tepe veren parça Numune 21'dir.
entries.text: The part that produces two small peaks without using a Splitter is Sample 21.

entries.source: Tepelerin boyu korunmalı; Numune 21'den sonra Geciktirici bağla.
entries.text: Peak heights must be preserved; connect a Delay Unit after Sample 21.

entries.source: Sert iğne tepkisini iki kola ayır; iki kolu da sönümle, yalnız birini geciktir.
entries.text: Split the sharp needle response into two branches; attenuate both branches and delay only one.

entries.source: Dar ve keskin tepe Numune 46'dan gelir; ham hali hedef izden daha yüksektir.
entries.text: The narrow, sharp peak comes from Sample 46; its raw form is taller than the target trace.

entries.source: Her iki tepe de alçaltılmıştır; Dağıtıcı'dan sonraki iki kolda da Sönümleyici gerekir.
entries.text: Both peaks are lowered; an Attenuator is required on both branches after the Splitter.

entries.source: Bir kolda merkez kubbeyi koru, diğer kolda iğne tepkiyi geciktirip sönümleyerek birleştir.
entries.text: Preserve the center dome on one branch, and delay and attenuate the needle response on the other before combining.

entries.source: Geniş orta tepe Numune 08'den, sağdaki keskin tepe Numune 46'dan gelir.
entries.text: The wide middle peak comes from Sample 08, and the sharp right peak comes from Sample 46.

entries.source: Numune 46 kolu hem Geciktirici hem Sönümleyici ister; Numune 08 kolu doğrudan ölçere gidebilir.
entries.text: The Sample 46 branch requires both a Delay Unit and an Attenuator; the Sample 08 branch can go straight to the meter.

entries.source: Kırmızı ve yeşil pigmenti birleştir, sonra taşıyıcı sıvı ile seyrelterek dengeli kehribar karışımı üret.
entries.text: Combine red and green pigments, then dilute with carrier fluid to produce a balanced amber mixture.

entries.source: Kehribar ton için Kırmızı Pigment ve Yeşil Pigment eşit miktarda birleşmelidir.
entries.text: For an amber tone, Red Pigment and Green Pigment must combine in equal amounts.

entries.source: Saf pigment karışımı fazla yoğundur. İkinci bir Karıştırıcı Kap ile 1 doz Taşıyıcı Sıvı ekle.
entries.text: Pure pigment mixture is too dense. Add 1 dose of Carrier Fluid using a second Mixer Vessel.

entries.source: Son karışım 3 doz olmalı ve Karışım Ölçer'e tek hattan girmelidir.
entries.text: The final mixture must be 3 doses and enter the Mixture Analyzer through a single line.

entries.source: Yeşil ve mavi pigmentleri taşıyıcı sıvı ile kur, ardından seyrelticiden geçirerek açık camgöbeği elde et.
entries.text: Prepare green and blue pigments with carrier fluid, then pass through a diluter to obtain light cyan.

entries.source: Renk yalnız Yeşil Pigment ve Mavi Pigment'ten oluşur; kırmızı kullanılmaz.
entries.text: The color consists only of Green Pigment and Blue Pigment; red is not used.

entries.source: Taşıyıcı Sıvı eklendikten sonra bile karışım koyu kalır; Karışım Ölçer'den önce Seyreltici bağla.
entries.text: Even after adding Carrier Fluid, the mixture remains dark; connect a Diluter before the Mixture Analyzer.

entries.source: Kırmızı ağırlıklı mor bir karışım kur: mavi pigmenti ikiye böl, kırmızı ve taşıyıcı sıvı ile birleştirip yoğunlaştır.
entries.text: Create a red-dominant purple mixture: split the blue pigment in two, combine with red and carrier fluid, and concentrate.

entries.source: Hedef renkte kırmızı oranı mavinin iki katıdır. Mavi Pigment'i Bölücü Kap ile iki yarım doza ayır.
entries.text: In the target color, the red ratio is twice that of blue. Split the Blue Pigment into two half-doses with a Splitter Vessel.

entries.source: Bölücü Kap'tan çıkan yarım doz mavi kollarından biri kırmızıyla, diğeri taşıyıcı sıvıyla birleşebilir; ikinci mavi kolu seyreltip son karışıma kat.
entries.text: One of the half-dose blue branches from the Splitter Vessel can combine with red and the other with carrier fluid; dilute the second blue branch and add it to the final mixture.

entries.source: Birleşen sıvıyı Karışım Ölçer'e vermeden önce Yoğunlaştırıcı'dan geçir.
entries.text: Pass the combined fluid through a Concentrator before feeding it into the Mixture Analyzer.

entries.text: 1. Drop the target diagram into the TARGET slot at the top right.

entries.source: 2. İpuçlarını sağdaki BİLGİLER alanına sürükle; bilinmeyen parçalar açılır.
entries.text: 2. Drag clues into the CLUES area on the right to reveal unknown parts.
3. Place these parts on the board: {0}.

entries.source: 5. DENEYİ ÖLÇ düğmesine bas; çıkan ölçüm kartını deftere veya Turing'in sol yuvaya sürükle.
entries.text: 5. Press MEASURE EXPERIMENT; drag the resulting measurement card into the notebook or the left slot on the Turing machine.
3. Place these parts on the board: {0}.

entries.source: 4. Bağları çiz; {0} bağlantısında aynı iki uç arasında ikinci kez çizerek çift bağ (=) yap.
entries.text: 4. Draw the bonds; on the {0} connection, draw a second time between the same two nodes to create a double bond (=).

entries.source: 4. Parçaların uçları arasında tek bağları çiz.
entries.text: 4. Draw single bonds between the part nodes.

entries.source: 5. SENTEZLE / TEST ET düğmesine bas ve doğrulanan kodu Turing'e gir.
entries.text: 5. Press SYNTHESIZE / TEST and enter the verified code into the Turing machine.

entries.text: Red Pigment + Green Pigment → Mixer Vessel 1

entries.source: Başlangıç: 0,18 anında tek uyarım yollar. Yükseklik 1; giriş yok, bir çıkış.
entries.text: Initial pulse: sends a single excitation at time 0.18. Height 1; no input, one output.

entries.source: Kısa tepki: gelen izin genişliğini 0,025 yapar. Zaman ve yükseklik korunur.
entries.text: Short response: sets the incoming trace width to 0.025. Time and height are preserved.

entries.source: Sonuç: bir veya iki girişten gelen izleri aynı kayda çizer. Çıkış yok.
entries.text: Result: records traces from one or two inputs on the same chart. No output.

entries.source: Gelen her izi iki çıkışına da iletir. Her çıkışa ayrı bir hat bağlanır.
entries.text: Sends each incoming trace to both outputs. Connect a separate line to each output.

entries.source: Her izi 0,32 zaman birimi geciktirir. Yükseklik ve genişlik korunur.
entries.text: Delays every trace by 0.32 time units. Height and width are preserved.

entries.source: Her izin yüksekliğini yarıya indirir. Zaman ve genişlik korunur.
entries.text: Halves the height of every trace. Time and width are preserved.

entries.source: Geniş tepki: gelen izin genişliğini 0,075 yapar. Zaman ve yükseklik korunur.
entries.text: Wide response: sets the incoming trace width to 0.075. Time and height are preserved.

entries.source: Zayıf tepki: genişliği 0,025 yapar ve yüksekliği yarıya indirir. Zaman korunur.
entries.text: Weak response: sets the width to 0.025 and halves the height. Time is preserved.

entries.source: Geç tepki: genişliği 0,025 yapar ve 0,16 zaman birimi geciktirir. Yükseklik korunur.
entries.text: Late response: sets the width to 0.025 and delays the trace by 0.16 time units. Height is preserved.

entries.source: Çift tepki: her giriş izini iki kez yollar; ikinci iz 0,32 sonra gelir. Genişlik ve yükseklik korunur. Tek çıkış hattı yeterlidir.
entries.text: Double response: sends each incoming trace twice; the second arrives 0.32 later. Width and height are preserved. One output line is enough.

entries.source: 1 doz renksiz taşıyıcı sıvı verir. Pigment içermez.
entries.text: Supplies 1 dose of colorless carrier fluid. Contains no pigment.

entries.source: Geçen karışıma 1 doz kırmızı pigment ekler. Miktar da 1 doz artar.
entries.text: Adds 1 dose of red pigment to the passing mixture. Total volume also increases by 1 dose.

entries.source: Geçen karışıma 1 doz yeşil pigment ekler. Miktar da 1 doz artar.
entries.text: Adds 1 dose of green pigment to the passing mixture. Total volume also increases by 1 dose.

entries.source: Geçen karışıma 1 doz mavi pigment ekler. Miktar da 1 doz artar.
entries.text: Adds 1 dose of blue pigment to the passing mixture. Total volume also increases by 1 dose.

entries.source: 1 doz renksiz taşıyıcı ekler. Pigment oranları korunur; yoğunluk azalır, toplam miktar artar.
entries.text: Adds 1 dose of colorless carrier. Pigment ratios are preserved; concentration decreases and total volume increases.

entries.source: Renksiz taşıyıcının yarısını uzaklaştırır. Pigment miktarı korunur; yoğunluk artar, toplam miktar azalır.
entries.text: Removes half of the colorless carrier. Pigment amounts are preserved; concentration increases and total volume decreases.

entries.source: Karışımı iki eşit kola böler. Her kolda bütün bileşenlerin yarısı bulunur; toplam miktar korunur.
entries.text: Splits the mixture into two equal branches. Each branch contains half of every component; total volume is preserved.

entries.source: İki girişten gelen sıvıları toplar. Renk pigment miktarlarına göre oluşur; iki giriş de bağlanmalı.
entries.text: Combines fluids from two inputs. Color depends on pigment amounts; both inputs must be connected.

entries.source: Son karışımın rengini, pigment yoğunluğunu ve toplam miktarını ölçer. Çıkışı yoktur.
entries.text: Measures the final mixture color, pigment concentration, and total volume. Has no output.

entries.source: Bu deneyde tek numune kullan. Kısa tepkisini iki farklı anda kaydet; izler hedefle örtüşmeli.
entries.text: Use a single sample in this experiment. Record its short response at two different times; the traces must match the target.

entries.source: Gözlemlerden yararlanarak hedefteki kaydı üret. Deneyin koşulları ve parça adetleri kitaplarda açıklanır.
entries.text: Use your observations to reproduce the target recording. The experiment conditions and part quantities are explained in the books.

entries.source: Hedefteki karışımı üret. Renk oranları, pigment yoğunluğu ve toplam miktar birlikte tutmalı; deney koşulları kitaplarda.
entries.text: Produce the target mixture. Color ratios, pigment concentration, and total volume must all match; the experiment conditions are in the books.

entries.source: Koruyucu kaplamanın arşiv numunesi bulundu. Analizörde bu referansın rengini, yoğunluğunu ve miktarını yeniden elde et.
entries.text: An archived sample of the protective coating has been found. Reproduce this reference color, concentration, and volume in the analyzer.

entries.source: Yoğunlaştırma yalnız renksiz taşıyıcıyı azaltır. Çözücü yeniden taşıyıcı ekler. Aynı iki işlemi farklı sırada deneyince farklı numuneler elde edildi.
entries.text: Concentration removes only the colorless carrier. Solvent adds carrier again. Applying the same two operations in a different order produced different samples.

entries.source: Benzer renk tek başına yeterli değildir. Referans numunenin yoğunluğunu ve kapta kalan miktarı da karşılaştır; küçük denemelerle ilerle.
entries.text: A similar color alone is not enough. Also compare the reference sample concentration and the volume left in the vessel; proceed with small experiments.

entries.source: Uyarı devresinin eski kaydını yeniden üret. Kaydın iki tepkisinin biçimini, gücünü ve aralarındaki aralığı gözlemle.
entries.text: Reproduce the old recording of the excitation circuit. Observe the shape and strength of its two responses and the interval between them.

entries.source: Tek başına denendiğinde ince ve kısa bir iz bırakır. Uyarının geliş anını ve gücünü korur.
entries.text: When tested alone, it leaves a thin, short trace. The excitation arrival time and strength are preserved.

entries.source: İçinden geçen tepki daha sonra görünür. Genişlik ve güç değişmez; tekrar kullanılırsa bekleme uzar.
entries.text: The response passing through it appears later. Width and strength are unchanged; repeated use increases the wait.

entries.source: İçinden geçen tepkiyi sönükleştirir. İz aynı yerde ve aynı genişlikte kalır; tekrarlamak onu daha da zayıflatır.
entries.text: Weakens the response passing through it. The trace stays in the same position and keeps its width; repeated use makes it even weaker.

entries.source: Tepkiyi geniş bir iz haline getirir. Uyarının geliş anını ve gücünü korur.
entries.text: Turns the response into a wide trace. The excitation arrival time and strength are preserved.

entries.source: Gelen tepkiyi kısa ve sönük bir iz haline getirir. Tek başına N-12'den daha zayıf görünür.
entries.text: Turns the incoming response into a short, faint trace. On its own it appears weaker than N-12.

entries.source: Kısa bir tepki bırakır; yanıtı normal numuneden sonra gelir. Bu bekleme, geciktiricinin beklemesinden daha kısadır.
entries.text: Leaves a short response that arrives after the normal sample. This wait is shorter than the delay unit wait.

entries.source: Her uyarıya aralıklı iki yanıt verir. Yanıtların biçimini ve gücünü korur; tek giriş ve tek çıkışı vardır.
entries.text: Produces two spaced responses for each excitation. Their shape and strength are preserved; it has one input and one output.

entries.source: Bir işlem, kendi içinden geçen tepkileri değiştirir. Başka bir hatta ilerleyen tepki, bu işlemden etkilenmez.
entries.text: An operation changes the responses passing through it. A response traveling along another line is not affected by that operation.

entries.source: Önce her numunenin tek başına bıraktığı izi tanı. Sonra eski kayıttaki tepkilerle karşılaştır; hedefin çizdiği bağlantıyı değil, davranışını yeniden oluştur.
entries.text: First learn the trace each sample leaves on its own. Then compare it with the responses in the old recording; reproduce the target behavior rather than its wiring diagram.

entries.source: Uzak istasyondan kalan bu kaydı geri getir. Referansın başlangıcını, tepki sayısını ve izlerin biçimini birlikte incele.
entries.text: Recover this recording from the remote station. Examine the reference start time, number of responses, and trace shapes together.

entries.source: Numuneler aynı özelliği değiştiriyorsa, daha sonra karşılaşılan numunenin izi son kayıtta belirginleşir. Her işlemin zaman, biçim ve güç üzerindeki etkisini ayrı ayrı gözle.
entries.text: When samples change the same property, the sample encountered later determines the final trace. Observe how each operation affects time, shape, and strength separately.

entries.source: Birden fazla tepki üreten numune de normal bir hat üzerinde çalışabilir. Tepki sayısıyla hat sayısını aynı şey sanma.
entries.text: A sample producing multiple responses can also work on a normal line. Do not confuse the number of responses with the number of lines.

entries.source: Rengi, pigment yoğunluğunu ve toplam miktarı hedefle karşılaştır.
entries.text: Compare the color, pigment concentration, and total volume with the target.

entries.source: Zamanı, genişliği ve yüksekliği hedefle karşılaştır.
entries.text: Compare the time, width, and height with the target.

entries.source: Halka giriş, ok çıkıştır. Bir uçtan tek hat çıkar. Tek kaynak ve tek ölçer kullan. Bütün parçalar kaynaktan beslenip ölçere ulaşmalı.
entries.text: A ring marks an input; an arrow marks an output. Each port takes one line. Use one source and one meter. Every part must receive flow from the source and reach the meter.

entries.source: Renk pigment oranlarından oluşur. Yoğunluk, pigment / toplam miktardır. Aynı görünen rengin miktarı veya yoğunluğu farklı olabilir.
entries.text: Color comes from pigment ratios. Concentration is pigment divided by total volume. Mixtures that look the same can have different volumes or concentrations.

entries.source: Aynı anda, aynı genişlikte gelen izlerin yükseklikleri toplanır. Kayıtta tek görünür iz oluşur.
entries.text: Traces arriving at the same time with the same width add their heights together. They form one visible trace in the recording.

entries.source: Dağıtıcı miktarları yarıya böler; karıştırıcı iki kolu toplar. Pigment ekleme, seyreltme ve yoğunlaştırmanın sırası sonucu değiştirebilir.
entries.text: The splitter halves the quantities; the mixer combines two branches. Changing the order of pigment addition, dilution, and concentration can change the result.

entries.source: Her numunenin ve işlem parçasının etkisi, içinden geçen her ize uygulanır. Sıra ve dallanma sonucu değiştirebilir.
entries.text: Each sample and processing part affects every trace passing through it. Order and branching can change the result.

entries.source: Tahtada DENEYİ ÖLÇ. Ölçüm kağıdını deftere al; Turing'in sol klavyesindeki okuyucuya bırak. Kod hazır olunca Enter ile sına.
entries.text: MEASURE THE EXPERIMENT on the board. Collect the measurement paper in your notebook, then drop it in the reader on the left side of the Turing keyboard. When the code is ready, press Enter to test it.
Do not use {0} in this experiment.

The frequency on this oscilloscope looks familiar... If I match the wave on the screen, I can obtain the password.
Now its time to explode to bomb...
There's a password here! I found one, I should note this down and try it on the Turing machine right away.
You need to write everything you know
That sound... He's coming here! I must hide inside the locker right now!
Dont Forget to close your doors

entries.source: Önce defterdeki kalibrasyon şemasına bakmalıyım. [Tab] ile açıp hedefi ve parçaları tahtaya sürükleyebilirim.
entries.text: First I should check the calibration diagram in my notebook. I can open it with [{input:ToggleNotebook}] and drag the target and parts onto the board.

entries.source: Sentez tamamlandı. Tahtanın verdiği kodu Turing makinesine girersem kilit açılacak.
entries.text: Synthesis complete. If I enter the code from the board into the Turing machine, the lock will open.
That book on the desk... Maybe it can tell us what happened here.
I'm still thinking about that book. Aren't you curious?
On the desk right in front of you. Click the book and we can take a look.
The target, connection note and three parts... We could keep them in your notebook. Tab opens it.
Those notes will stay on the pages. Drag them into your notebook and we can take them with us.
Something's still missing. The target, connection order and three parts on the other page... We may need all of them.
Good, we have everything. We could try something with these on that chalkboard.
I think we're done with the book. F puts it down, then we can try the board.
The notes won't disappear; they're in your notebook. F lets us leave the book and look around.
The chalkboard... Maybe we can work out how these pieces fit together there.
I'm curious about the board. We could try out what we took from the book.
Clicking that chalkboard lets us work. Your notes are in the notebook; Tab brings them up.
It would be easier to think with the target and connection note side by side on that panel.
Your notebook had Targets and Information. We can move a note from each onto the panel.
The target and connection order... Drag both onto the panel and we'll have them in sight.
We could use some room now. I think that handle above the panel folds the documents away.
That BELGELERİ TOPLA handle... We can clear the working area without losing the notes.
Closing the panel with its handle makes room for the parts. We can open it again later.
We can bring the three parts from your notebook onto the board. That note had the connection order.
Arrows are outputs, rings are inputs... We can drag between them to connect them. I'm curious what we'll get.
We could check the connection note again. DENEYİ ÖLÇ measures it; right-click removes a wrong connection.
That trace... We'll need it. We can keep the measurement paper in your notebook.
If we leave that paper here, we'll have to come back. Dragging it into your notebook might be better.
The measurement paper is still on the board. Drag it into your notebook and we can take it along.
The measurement's in your notebook. We've been here a while... We should probably check the door.
I think we're done with the board for now. F lets us leave.
Your notes are safe. Once we leave the board with F, we can check the door.
That door... I don't like how easily someone could walk in here.
Did you notice the lock? I'd feel a little safer if that door were locked.
The lock on the office door... A click on it should do it.
Footsteps... You heard them too, right? They might not see us in that wardrobe.
It's getting closer. The wardrobe's still right there...
We can click the marked wardrobe. I really don't want to be seen right now.
I'm here. Let's stay quiet a little longer... Someone's still out there.
They haven't gone yet. Staying here feels safer.
I'm listening. I'll tell you when it feels safe.
The footsteps have faded. I think we can look outside now.
I can't hear anyone by the door now. F was the way out, remember?
We don't have to stay in here. F lets you leave the wardrobe.
Wait a second... Something in the room has changed. I'm not sure we're alone.
There's something in the room. Did you see it too?
Be careful looking around... I can feel someone here.
Lees... Looking at him feels wrong. Maybe look away... and stay still for a moment.
Are your eyes still on him? I'd look somewhere else and wait quietly.
He might leave if you look away and stop moving... I'm here.
All right... We still have the measurement. I wonder what Turing will make of that paper.
The paper from the board is in your notebook. We could try it in that Turing machine.
Click Turing and we can reach its reader. The paper is under Measurements in your notebook.
The reader on the left keyboard... That measurement paper looks like it would fit.
We can move the First Trace paper from Measurements in your notebook into the reader.
Dragging the paper to that slot on the left keyboard lets the machine read it.
It's working... Let's give it time to read the paper. I'm curious about the result too.
It's still reading. We can give the machine a little more time.
Once the code settles, it'll be ready. It seems to be finishing up.
The code's in place. Enter should tell us whether our measurement holds up.
It looks ready. I think Enter is all that's left before we see the result.
It's finished reading, but we haven't tested it yet. Enter lets Turing give its verdict.
That pressure noise... It might be coming from the valve room. We should have a look.
The door to the valve room was marked. The sound seems to be coming from there.
The marked door leads to the valves. I don't feel right ignoring that sound.
That gauge doesn't look good. Do you think turning the valve would lower the pressure?
The needle's still high. Clicking the valve and turning with the mouse should move it.
Twenty or below... We can breathe easier once the needle gets there.
The needle's down. That's better... F lets us leave the valve.
The pressure's low enough now. I don't think we need to stay here.
We're done with the valve. F lets us step back.
That silence... Let's listen for a moment.
It feels like something's about to happen. Do you feel it too?
I'm still here. We can take a look around.
The lights... I think the breaker tripped. The main switch should be in the breaker room.
I don't like staying in the dark. We could check the breaker room.
Clicking the main switch in the breaker room should bring the power back.
That record didn't match. We need the First Trace measurement that meets the target in your notebook.
We made more than one attempt. We can feed the paper with one short trace into the reader again.
Confirming the same record won't change the result. We could try the matching paper under Measurements.
